title: Compact grid interaction QA sweep — touch scrolling & cross-browser quirks
creator: Maya Patel
description: Perform a focused QA and triage pass on the compact/dense component grid and its primary building blocks (buttons, tables, small charts) to surface regressions introduced by recent token updates. Investigate touch-scrolling stutters, unexpected focus rings, clipped chart tooltips at small breakpoints, and table row hit target shrinkage across Safari (iOS/macOS), Firefox, and Android WebView. Consolidate reproducible steps, severity, and recommended fixes for platform owners.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce each reported issue with minimal steps and attach repro screenshots/videos
Assign fixes or design guidance for each unique root cause
Provide token change roll-back recommendations when token diff causes visual regression
Create follow-up engineering tickets for platform-specific fixes and a design spec for density token behavior
Mark high-impact issues with clear temporary workarounds for customers
steps_to_reproduce: Open demo: /ui-kit/compact-grid on iPhone 14 / iOS 17 Safari in portrait; scroll the grid quickly with two-finger flick — observe stutter and item misalignment
On macOS Safari, navigate grid with keyboard Tab — focus outline appears offset for compact buttons
Open demo in Firefox on desktop with reduced font size (90%) — compact table rows collapse visually and overflow indicators are hidden
Load compact charts with tooltips in Android System WebView (Pixel 6) and tap data point near right edge — tooltip is clipped off-canvas
Apply density token set: density.compact = true in the playground and compare against baseline Medium tokens to reproduce hit-target shrinkage on action buttons
triage_notes: Observed regressions correlate with 'density-token' css variable rename in last token pass — likely migration edge cases
Some issues are platform-renderer specific: Safari compositing + sticky positioning causing jitter; Firefox has different rounding on subpixel layout
Android WebView clipping appears related to overflow:hidden on parent wrapper introduced by compact-grid's responsive clip hack
Keyboard focus offset seems to come from a 2px negative margin applied to compact-button to tighten visual spacing — breaks focus ring calculation
investigation_findings: Confirmed compact-button uses -2px margin shorthand on macOS Safari which shifts outline rendering in Blink/WebKit differently than Gecko
Dense table row height reduction removed min-height constraint — on Firefox fractional subpixel rounding reduces row height below expected touch targets
Chart tooltip container uses position: absolute inside a clipping ancestor; on Android WebView the clipping ancestor inherits transform causing stacking context issues
Token diff: spacing.small was reduced from 6px to 4px; touch-target token was not updated in some variants leading to <44px tappable areas
proposed_actions: Reintroduce min-touch-target token and map compact variants to preserve accessibility (44px) where semantic actions are present
Replace negative margin hack on compact-button with CSS gap/inline-flex adjustments; update focus-offset token to be additive rather than absolute
For dense table rows, add platform-aware min-height and use -webkit-font-smoothing fallbacks to reduce Firefox rounding issues
Adjust ChartSmall tooltip to render in portal (body) when near container edge to avoid clipping in WebView
Create ENG tickets for small CSS/JS fixes per platform and link back here; provide temporary CSS overrides for hosted docs while fixes land
